gitCommit.subject: Console: platform-superadmin provisioning and persistent test businesses (D217)
gitCommit.body:
Console: platform-superadmin provisioning and persistent test businesses (D217)

- New business (/admin/businesses/new): a business and its Owner, a test
  business by default; one key per set of answers so a retry finds the same
  business; the Owner's one-time setup code shown once, never stored, gone when
  handed over. The Owner's number stays unverified; nothing is sent.
- Business page: an unmistakable test banner and badge; "Setup and access"
  tells provisioning (the Owner's password) and activation (the subscription)
  apart, with the setup code's state and the contacts' verification and
  consent; issue or reissue the setup code after a step-up; set or clear the
  test status with a reason; add a store (granted under a test business's
  grant, or a customer's priced request). No payment decision for a test
  business.
- Businesses list marks test businesses and links to New business; the
  dashboard says how many test businesses its figures leave out.
- Provisioning refusals said in EN/FR/AR by their code. Arabic names a test
  business "اختباري", never "تجريبي", the free trial's word.
- Tests: provisioning-console (10), French "Test" allowed as English writes it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
